$comment: Coverage thresholds for the dashboard MVP. Lines stay at 100%; the other axes are slightly relaxed to acknowledge defensive guards that are unreachable by construction (already marked with /* v8 ignore */ where appropriate). A follow-up issue tracks raising every axis back to 100% strict.

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. If coverage drops below any threshold, the task fails.
